# AYZEN

> AYZEN is a Web3 workspace of 8 connected modules for airdrop teams and crypto builders: vault, wallets, finance, marketplace, airdrops, teams, mail and an AI assistant.

AYZEN runs as separate modules, each with its own account, session and data. Nothing is shared between modules unless the person connects them.

## Modules

- [Sylo](https://sylo.ayzen.tech/): Vault — credentials, entities and wallets.
- [Ryft](https://ryft.ayzen.tech/): Ryft — wallet hub and wallet analysis.
- [Fyra](https://fyra.ayzen.tech/): Fyra — finance: cash flow, loans, investments, assets.
- [Verve](https://verve.ayzen.tech/): Verve — marketplace and P2P trading.
- [Skarn](https://skarn.ayzen.tech/): Skarn — airdrop projects, tasks and operator progress.
- [Warde](https://warde.ayzen.tech/): Warde — farming teams, chat and missions.
- [Wisp](https://wisp.ayzen.tech/): Wisp — AYZEN mailbox and email accounts.
- [Zynth](https://zynth.ayzen.tech/): Zynth — AI assistant.

## Pages

- [AYZEN overview](https://ayzen.tech/landing/): what AYZEN is
- [Sign in](https://ayzen.tech/login): sign in with your AYZEN account
- [Create account](https://ayzen.tech/register): create an AYZEN account

## Pricing

Starting is free. Heavier usage is paid in Shards, AYZEN's usage credits.
